subject: maths
question:
Monthly expenditure of a family on different heads is shown in the following pie chart. The family earns ₹1,08,000 every month.

What is the amount spent on Rent every month (in ₹)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04266abc03d162473a8de77d199f36d23c3b34c56ca75cd78f602ca4e42722f3.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Monthly expenses on Rent = 108000 × (60°/360°)

⇒ 18000

**∴ Required expense on rent is Rs. 18000.**
